lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Italian authorities evacuated hundreds of schools Wednesday after an emailed bomb threat, the latest in a series of disruptions affecting European institutions following recent hoaxes aimed at airlines and broadcasters, The Canadian Press reports.

A large-scale prisoner exchange emerged as the only tangible result of two days of US-mediated talks between Ukraine and Russia in Abu Dhabi, with no breakthrough on a ceasefire or territorial disputes. #EuropeNews, Euronews reports.
Some Democrats who missed key procedural vote to impeach Pete Hegseth blame traffic jam in DC – US politics live, The Guardian reports.
The circumstances surrounding the death prompted an investigation by the OPP crime unit, with assistance from the Ontario Coroner’s Office, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
